designationHistory.indexText: The Fish and Wildlife Service acquired a 3,802-acre easement on bottomland hardwood forest along the Sabine River in Wood County, Texas, creating the Little Sandy National Wildlife Refuge.

authority.citation: Acquisition of a conservation easement (1986 environmental assessment)

designationHistory.note: Only the year of the easement acquisition is documented.
